newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla cattle trade active at $70 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla cattle trade active at $70 - USDA.

text.p: Trade active in the panhandle area Wednesday. Slaughter steers and heifers 2.00 lower.

Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 19,500 slaughter steers and 11,200 heifers; 50,900 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 11,600 formulated and 800 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Wk to Date: 50,900 Week Ago:62,500 Year Ago: 39,600
Slaughter Steers: Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 69.50 to mostly 70.00, few North Plains 71.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 69.00.
Slaughter Heifers: Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 69.50 to mostly 70.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 69.00.
